name: Parker
description:
Parker connects Claude to your brand's ad intelligence and creative research workflows. With Parker, you can analyze Meta ad performance, research competitors, mine customer reviews, generate creative briefs and much more — all directly inside Claude.

Parker is built for performance marketers, creative strategists, and DTC brand teams who want faster, data-driven decisions about what to create next.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Parker to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Parker to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.heyparker.ai/api/mcp/full. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Parker MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Parker lists 25 MCP tools, including analyze_video_from_url, brand_discovery, get_available_brands, get_brand_persona, get_current_time, get_webpage, list_custom_metrics, lookup_post_purchase_survey, manage_insights_subscriptions, search_chat_history, search_competitor_facebook_ads, and search_customer_reviews_semantic.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Parker?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Parker in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Parker requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Parker is developed by Real Simple Labs, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
